name: shell-unwrap
description: Applies shell permission rules to wrapped commands, as an OpenCode plugin and a Claude Code hook

scripts.check: bun run embed && tsc --noEmit && bun run build && bun test
scripts.build: bun run embed && bun build src/opencode.ts --target bun --outfile dist/opencode/shell-unwrap.js && bun build src/claude.ts --target bun --outfile dist/claude/shell-unwrap.js
